title: SAFE-ESO_Phase II study evaluating safety and efficacy of Tislelizumab for elderly patients unfit for chemotherapy, with advanced esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma
official: SAFE-ESO_Phase II study evaluating safety and efficacy of Tislelizumab for elderly patients unfit for chemotherapy, with advanced esophageal squamous-cell carcinoma
summary: Main objective: Assess the rate of evaluable patients (i.e., those not lost to follow-up at 6 months and who have received at least one dose of the study treatment) who are alive at 6 months after inclusion.
conditions: Squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus

interventions.name: Tevimbra 100 mg concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically proven squamous cell carcinoma of the esophagus (ESCC)
2. Metastatic or locally advanced cancer
3. Absence of previous treatment (immunotherapy, chemotherapy or radiotherapy) in first line setting
4. Ineligibility for a platinum-based chemotherapy assessed by oncologist and geriatrician
5. At least one evaluable and/or measurable lesion as defined by RECIST v1.1 criteria
6. Patients ≥ 70 years
7. Subjects with WHO performance status ≤ 2
Exclusion criteria:
1. History of another primary malignancy
2. Persons deprived of liberty or under guardianship or incapable of giving consent
3. Locally advanced esophageal carcinoma that is resectable or potentially curable with radiation therapy per local investigator
4. History of allogenic organ, bone marrow, or double umbilical cord blood transplantation
5. Active documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders
6. Previous immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy within the 2 years before inclusion
7. Patients with evidence of fistula (either oesophageal/bronchial or oesophageal/aorta)
8. Patients with myelodysplastic syndrome/acute myeloid leukaemia or with features suggestive of MDS/AML
9. Patient with symptomatic central nervous system (CNS) metastases
10. History of active primary immunodeficiency
